observed: Four errors on fresh load, including an invalid token and repeated blogPrefetching declarations.
root_cause: Template replacement interpreted JavaScript replacement tokens and duplicated source fragments.
fix: Use a replacement function for literal partial insertion and assert exactly one override block.

observed: 42 duplicate IDs made modal and listener behavior nondeterministic.
root_cause: The generated dashboard contained five copies of override and modal blocks.
fix: Rebuild from source and regression-test unique IDs.

error: Retired auth and billing controls exposed
observed: Log In and Upgrade contradicted the read-only public banner.
root_cause: The Sites generator only hid retired flows with CSS.
fix: Remove retired controls and Upgrade content from generated markup.

observed: Upgrade became active while computed display remained none.
root_cause: Retired content and navigation remained wired inconsistently.
fix: Remove the retired route from the Sites edition.

observed: Imports failed unless PYTHONPATH=. was manually supplied.
root_cause: Repository root was not configured as a pytest import path.
fix: Add pytest.ini with pythonpath and testpaths.

observed: /docs loaded its shell, but API_DOCS.md and LLM.txt both failed to load.
root_cause: Flask served docs.html but did not expose either source document URL consumed by the page.
fix: Add explicit UTF-8 Flask routes for API_DOCS.md and LLM.txt plus endpoint regression coverage.

error: Latest returned a hard-coded empty success payload
observed: The production route reported count 0 and items [] while the live upstream feed contained current items; the UI appeared empty without an honest failure.
root_cause: Sites app/latest/route.ts and the Agent compatibility route defined static empty Latest objects instead of querying the live aggregator.
fix: Replace both routes and preview with transparent live proxies, preserve upstream errors as 502 responses, use live cache for normal loads, and reserve forced refresh for the Refresh action.

error: Nullable model fields crashed search filtering
observed: Typing flux left all 250 cards visible after toLowerCase was called on null metadata.
root_cause: The filter assumed name, description, and owner were always strings.
fix: Normalize every searchable field before case folding.

observed: claude plus anthropic produced zero results despite matching records.
root_cause: Typed vendor text was compared exactly against title-cased provider values.
fix: Trim and case-normalize both vendor values.

error: Live records had no usable tag taxonomy
observed: All 360 live records rendered with an All Tags-only selector.
root_cause: The upstream feed currently returns empty tag arrays.
fix: Add a disclosed deterministic inferred taxonomy and populate tags during preview and full loads.

error: Agent query could be lost during iframe navigation
observed: The Agent section opened but the unmatched query was absent.
root_cause: A single delayed delivery raced iframe creation and load.
fix: Deliver on iframe load and retry during the navigation settle window.

error: Generated links targeted an unreliable outer root route
observed: Copied section and shared-view URLs could open an empty root instead of the dashboard state.
root_cause: Link generation used location.origin plus / while the functional app is dashboard.html.
fix: Generate explicit dashboard.html section and view URLs and preserve search restoration.

observed: The sticky AI Dashboard has moved notice occupied the top interaction area.
root_cause: A migration notice was injected into every generated dashboard page.
fix: Remove the notice entirely from generated markup.

error: Agent advertised demo mode and substituted fake fallback models
observed: The model selector said Dashboard Data Demo and code could return invented Demo model rows or a fake Latest item.
root_cause: The Agent surface was built around a local demonstration fallback.
fix: Remove all fabricated model/news fallbacks, label the live Agent honestly, and surface upstream errors without sample substitution.
